The '''Unidentified wounded Bith Jedi''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Null/Legends|Null]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At sometime during his posting there he was wounded and taken to the [[Triage unit]] to be healed. He was treated by [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] who was an old friend of his. As he was being treated both he and T'ra sensed something approaching. Seconds later the unit was attacked by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Nazzer]] and his team of bounty hunters, riding [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], who were trying to claim the reward for killing jedi posted by the [[Crimson Nova]] chapter of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. The Bith Jedi was killed during the following battle along with several others when one of the first shots fired by the bounty hunters caught him in the chest.
